finalText:
All 12 files parsed clean, no failures.

Found the migration done in this session: memory not needed here, nothing surprising to record.

Found 12 files still calling the old `db.query`, and moved every one to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. They were `returnService.js`, `couponService.js`, `teamService.js`, `shipment.js`, `sla.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `session.js`, `cohort.js`, `refund.js`, `supplier.js`, and `variantAdmin.js`, three calls each: a get-by-id, a list, and an update.

One more spot still calls `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. I left it alone since its own comment says it's a vendored copy, replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so any edit there would be lost anyway.

All twelve files pass a syntax check. Nothing else in the codebase calls `db.query` now.
